stem: Amherst Legal has no hybrid connection today, needs to reach AWS for a small pilot by tomorrow, and separately expects a future compliance audit to require a dedicated, non-internet path once the pilot becomes permanent. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Order a hosted Direct Connect connection through a partner and expect it ready by tomorrow
Route the pilot's traffic over a Site-to-Site VPN and treat it as the eventual non-internet compliance answer
Configure Route 53 latency-based routing to reach the pilot environment by tomorrow
Reach AWS over the public internet with TLS for tomorrow's pilot traffic
Begin the Direct Connect ordering process now so a dedicated connection is ready before the audit

rationale: Public internet access with TLS is available immediately, meeting tomorrow's pilot deadline, while starting the Direct Connect order now gets a dedicated, non-internet connection in place before the audit. A hosted Direct Connect connection still takes longer than one day to provision. A Site-to-Site VPN always rides the public internet, so it can never satisfy the later non-internet requirement. Route 53 routing policies resolve names to endpoints, they do not establish network reachability by themselves.
